definitions.explanation: The time and energy required to do something.

examples.japanese: {手間|てま}がかかる{料理|りょうり}だ。
examples.english: It's a dish that takes a lot of effort to make.

examples.japanese: {手間|てま}を{省|はぶ}くために{機械|きかい}を{使|つか}う。
examples.english: I use a machine to save time and effort.

examples.japanese: お{手間|てま}を{取|と}らせて{申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ありません。

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
・{手間|てま}がかかる (to take time and effort)
・{手間|てま}を{省|はぶ}く (to save effort, to cut corners)
・{手間|てま}を{惜|お}しまない (to spare no effort)
・お{手間|てま}を{取|と}らせる (to cause trouble - polite)

COMMON COMPOUND WORDS:
・{手間|てま}{暇|ひま} (time and effort)
・{手間|てま}{賃|ちん} (labor charge, fee for work)
・{二度|にど}{手間|でま} (double work, having to do something twice)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{手間|てま}: Time and labor (neutral)
・{面倒|めんどう}: Trouble, bother (often implies annoyance)
